boxes.comments: Complete dark autograph head number. Rounded head and lower foot of 2; hooked head, descending stem and crossing stroke of 7.
Complete word with two opening and two closing quotation ticks. Tall b and h, lower ou/c/a/n bodies and terminal t visible; no neighboring text completed.
Initial tall looped d and detached final curved s-like return are visible. The flattened medial run does not securely separate e from compressed a/n; alternatives retained locally.

Two tall l strokes in celle. In associé the a, two s returns, o, c, dotted i, separate acute and one terminal e body are recoverable. No second final e body is separately secured; the literal ending is retained without agreement repair.

Cancellation crosses the whole short abbreviation. Initial p has a descending loop; the t has its own high short crossbar. A small terminal return may be s or part of the crossing; the deleted extent remains pts/pt without expansion.

Initial small a has no secure accent. Full fortiori and the de/passser-au sequence are enclosed (reading passer). The middle word has flattened a/v/a/n bodies and a pointed terminal t candidate; avant remains locally uncertain. The clipped continuation on the next line is not supplied.
Two compressed initial s forms, a separate hyphen, descending g loop, r/ou, p descender and terminal e. No separately secured final plural s.

On and de are secure. Between them an open r/v-like entry, round a body, detached dot and curved s/d-like return precede several pale low bodies; raison(ne) is graphically preferred but the word grouping remains unresolved against va donc. The following sign has two horizontal strokes and is transcribed literally as equals. No detached cedilla is secure under the c-shaped part of facon/façon; final se/en remains compressed.
Complete convaincre que. Low c/o/n/v/a, dotted i, n/c/r/e sequence; q with long descender followed by u/e. No ascender is supplied inside the first word.
Looped tall d, flattened e run and heavy terminal hooked return. The terminal s cannot be securely separated from the e return, so des/de remains local.

Complete sequence with both L groups, et un, two commas and the final unequal relation. The i marks have dots; the low numerals are 1 and 2. The relation has two bars crossed by an oblique stroke. No dots are converted to primes.
d loop and ascender, dotted i, s, t stem and bar, second dotted i, compressed n/c, second t and terminal s. The long connecting stroke belongs to the letters.

Large initial C body with a lower cedilla and following small a; capital form preferred from its size against the following h. marche has low m/a/r/c, tall h and final e. The crossing-looking return around Ça is not independently secured as cancellation.
Both parentheses, round 0, comma and two-lobed 3 are complete. A tiny clipped mark outside the right parenthesis is neighboring context and is not completed.
Open tall c-like entry, compressed a and hooked r ending support car; following en is complete. No grave accent is supplied above the first word.
One closed oval 0, comma, short 1 and both parentheses. The contact near the opening parenthesis is kept as the written pair rather than supplemented with another loop.
Initial d and apostrophe, a, second d ascender, compressed m/e, two t forms and r/e ending. Connecting strokes are retained as letter ductus.
Complete inline parenthesized 2: curved head, descending diagonal and lower foot, with both parentheses. Its placement precedes prose in the original page; no display tag role is assigned.

Full numbered formula. Label (3), a barred two-upright Pi/pi form, raised Gamma with a smaller raised round 0, equals and L with dotted low i. Capital/lowercase Pi is not settled by the two-stroke handwritten form and is marked locally. A clipped loop at the upper edge belongs to neighboring text and is not completed.

Complete parenthetical expression. donc has d/o and low n/c. Gamma is raised above the Pi/pi form; there is no small round exponent on this Gamma. Both parentheses around 1, comma, d'ailleurs and the outer parentheses are visible. A tiny spot immediately beyond the inner closing parenthesis may be a stop or its terminal ink; that punctuation is retained as an explicit local uncertainty.

Margin note read upright after a clockwise 22-degree rotation. À and the accented initial é, among the low flattened letters, are recoverable; second line parmi les, third conjectures with detached line-end hyphen, and fourth clefs with three final dots. The long j/f descenders and a separate oblique stroke to the lower right are visible. The isolated oblique stroke has no secured word or punctuation role; its extent is recorded here. The black scan boundary and faint parallel margin lines are not read as characters.
Complete lower-left foliation 54 in lighter, smaller strokes: top bar and curved lower body of 5, angled/stemmed 4. Retained as a marginal number.

method: Original page and all 22 prescribed fresh crops visually read. Crops made once from the original coordinates, autocontrasted, enlarged to 2800 pixels across with LANCZOS and mildly sharpened. B21 rotated clockwise 22 degrees. Selected unresolved places were reread in the same saved fresh crop without recropping. No OCR, witnesses, first-reading text, page notes, reports, or comparison were used.
